title: Healer - uploaded questionnaires with original numbering and source scoring
intendedUse: Faithful source-based digitization for technical integration and qualified review. This is separate from the earlier 174 original Healer questions; no participant answers, clinical validation or diagnostic results are supplied.
importantSafetyAndMethodology: Original item numbering restarts at 1 for each instrument and continues across its source pages. Printed Bengali numerals and machine-readable integers are both stored.
Question text is manually transcribed from the uploads. Line breaks and surrounding whitespace are normalized; known source wording discrepancies are flagged, not repaired.
The parallel DASS English wording comes from the uploaded English image and does not count as 21 extra questions. Do not infer cross-language equivalence.
Source scores, reversed SIAS options, weighted marital items and the paired marital item 12 are preserved. Do not use a single uniform scoring formula for all instruments.
Clinical interpretations are not enabled. Reference labels and thresholds are retained as source data, not diagnoses or validated app outputs.
Missing response handling, globally unique IDs and safety-review triggers are explicit implementation safeguards, not additional source questionnaire items.
Do not mix scores or apply these source cutoffs to the earlier original 174-question Healer bank.
The six nicotine scoring-key entries contain no question or answer text; they are excluded from the 155 questions.
This file does not establish translation validity, screening accuracy, normative validity, licensing, or clinical deployment readiness.

assessmentSelection.numberOfQuestionsToComplete: Use the full questionCount for the selected instrument. Do not randomly select ten questions or restart numbering on the second page.
